fields.english:
Ah, you have wonderful timing, <name>. I was beginning to wonder if all of my messengers had been successful. I'm glad to see they were, otherwise I would wager you'd still be out in the world learning more about all the threats that exist against our people.

Are you ready? Ready for more training I mean. You're growing in power more quickly, and I feel you are ready to learn more about our faith.

Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great <class>, <name>. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!

You are ready for your next lesson in service.

<name>, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great <class>, <name>. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!

You are ready for your next lesson in service.

Your race is so very clever, <name>. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to reclaiming your city, but with the burden of keeping your families safe in exile. That yearning for home must weigh heavily on you.

Word came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep her waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
